# What Render API keys the library redacts, and what it leaves alone.
#
# Every key here is built from the ordered run 0123456789abcdef, which no real
# credential is. That run is sixteen characters, so a body is it once and twelve
# characters of it again — the shortest body the pattern reads, since the count
# is a floor. It is spelled in lowercase where the case does not matter and in
# uppercase where the case is what a case is about: base62 holds the letters of
# both, so either spelling is a body.

patterns: render-api-key

# The one prefix Render issues an API key with. There is a single kind of string
# here rather than a table of them: one key authenticates against the whole API,
# over every workspace the account it belongs to is a member of, so nothing in
# the value says what it reaches, and the cases below are that one shape in the
# places a key is written.

case:     a key in an environment assignment
in:       RENDER_API_KEY=rnd_0123456789abcdef0123456789ab
out:      RENDER_API_KEY=«render-api-key»

case:     a key in the bearer authorization header the Render API is called with
in:       Authorization: Bearer rnd_0123456789abcdef0123456789ab
out:      Authorization: Bearer «render-api-key»

case:     a key in json
in:       {"key":"rnd_0123456789abcdef0123456789ab"}
out:      {"key":"«render-api-key»"}

case:     a key on a command line
in:       curl -H "Authorization: Bearer rnd_0123456789abcdef0123456789ab" https://api.render.com/v1/services
out:      curl -H "Authorization: Bearer «render-api-key»" https://api.render.com/v1/services

case:     a key in a configuration environment block
in:       "env": {"RENDER_API_KEY": "rnd_0123456789abcdef0123456789ab"}
out:      "env": {"RENDER_API_KEY": "«render-api-key»"}

case:     a key in yaml
in:       render_api_key: rnd_0123456789abcdef0123456789ab
out:      render_api_key: «render-api-key»

case:     a key in a diff line
in:       +RENDER_API_KEY=rnd_0123456789abcdef0123456789ab
out:      +RENDER_API_KEY=«render-api-key»

case:     a key in a markdown code span
in:       `rnd_0123456789abcdef0123456789ab`
out:      `«render-api-key»`

case:     a key in a clone url
in:       https://user:rnd_0123456789abcdef0123456789ab@api.render.com/v1
out:      https://user:«render-api-key»@api.render.com/v1

# The alphabet the twenty-eight characters are written in. It is base62 — the
# letters of both cases and the digits. The two characters base64url adds, the
# hyphen and the underscore, are not admitted, and either of them ends a body.

case:     a body written in capitals
in:       rnd_0123456789ABCDEF0123456789AB
out:      «render-api-key»

case:     a body written in the letters past f
in:       rnd_0123456789abcdefghijklmnopqrstuvwxyzGHIJKLMNOPQRSTUVWXYZ
out:      «render-api-key»

case:     a body carrying a hyphen
in:       rnd_0123456789abcdef-123456789ab
out:      rnd_0123456789abcdef-123456789ab

case:     a body carrying an underscore
in:       rnd_0123456789abcdef_123456789ab
out:      rnd_0123456789abcdef_123456789ab

case:     a hyphen straight behind the prefix
in:       rnd_-0123456789abcdef0123456789ab
out:      rnd_-0123456789abcdef0123456789ab

case:     an underscore straight behind the prefix
in:       rnd__0123456789abcdef0123456789ab
out:      rnd__0123456789abcdef0123456789ab

case:     a space straight behind the prefix
in:       rnd_ 0123456789abcdef0123456789ab
out:      rnd_ 0123456789abcdef0123456789ab

# The lengths either side of twenty-eight. The count is read as a floor rather
# than exactly, so twenty-seven characters are not a key and twenty-nine are one
# key to the end of its run rather than a key and a character left over. What
# the floor costs is the middle case — a key cut short of twenty-eight keeps
# every random character written in front of the cut, and none of them is
# redacted.

case:     a body of twenty-eight characters is a key
in:       rnd_0123456789abcdef0123456789ab
out:      «render-api-key»

case:     a body of twenty-seven characters is not
in:       rnd_0123456789abcdef0123456789a
out:      rnd_0123456789abcdef0123456789a

case:     an alphabet run longer than the floor is a key to the end of it
in:       rnd_0123456789abcdef0123456789abc
out:      «render-api-key»

# The names ordinary code writes with this prefix, where rnd abbreviates random.
# None of them reaches a body: a name is snake_case, and the underscore after
# its next word ends the run long before the twenty-eighth character. The
# shouted spelling is turned away by the case of the prefix instead.

case:     a generator state
in:       rnd_state = rnd_seed(rnd_next(seed));
out:      rnd_state = rnd_seed(rnd_next(seed));

case:     a shouted constant
in:       if (rnd_value > RND_MAX / 2) { }
out:      if (rnd_value > RND_MAX / 2) { }

# What a key may be written against. There is no boundary on either side of the
# prefix, so a key keeps its span whatever word character it abuts — and where
# the run of its alphabet carries on past the floor, what carries it on is
# redacted with the key. A hyphen and an underscore end the run instead.
#
# A name whose segment closes on rnd carries a whole prefix, so where
# twenty-eight unbroken characters of the alphabet stand behind one, everything
# from the rnd onward is redacted and only the syllable in front of it stays.

case:     a key after an underscore
in:       RENDER_API_KEY_rnd_0123456789abcdef0123456789ab
out:      RENDER_API_KEY_«render-api-key»

case:     a key after a letter
in:       xrnd_0123456789abcdef0123456789ab
out:      x«render-api-key»

case:     a name closing on the prefix with a body behind it
in:       seedrnd_0123456789abcdef0123456789ab
out:      seed«render-api-key»

case:     a rejected prefix standing directly in front of a whole key
in:       rnd_rnd_0123456789abcdef0123456789ab
out:      rnd_«render-api-key»

case:     a word written against a key
in:       rnd_0123456789abcdef0123456789absuffix
out:      «render-api-key»

case:     a hyphenated word written against a key
in:       rnd_0123456789abcdef0123456789ab-suffix
out:      «render-api-key»-suffix

case:     an underscored word written against a key
in:       rnd_0123456789abcdef0123456789ab_suffix
out:      «render-api-key»_suffix

case:     a key at the end of a sentence
in:       the key is rnd_0123456789abcdef0123456789ab.
out:      the key is «render-api-key».

case:     a key immediately against japanese on both sides
in:       鍵はrnd_0123456789abcdef0123456789abです
out:      鍵は«render-api-key»です

case:     a key against an invalid byte
in:       \xffrnd_0123456789abcdef0123456789ab\xff
out:      \xff«render-api-key»\xff

# Two keys written together. The three letters the prefix opens with belong to
# the alphabet a body is written in, so a body may close with rnd and the
# underscore of the next key stand directly behind it; the second key begins
# three characters before the first one ends, the two spans overlap and are
# redacted as one. Written with nothing at all between them the first body
# reaches three characters into the second prefix and stops at the underscore
# behind them, so those two overlap as well. Written with a space between them
# the two are separate values, and both go.

case:     a key beginning inside the key before it
in:       rnd_0123456789abcdef0123456789rnd_0123456789abcdef0123456789ab
out:      «render-api-key»

case:     two keys with nothing between them
in:       rnd_0123456789abcdef0123456789abrnd_0123456789ABCDEF0123456789AB
out:      «render-api-key»

case:     two keys separated by a space
in:       rnd_0123456789abcdef0123456789ab rnd_0123456789ABCDEF0123456789AB
out:      «render-api-key» «render-api-key»

# What this pattern redacts that nobody issued. The prefix closes with an
# underscore, which standard base64 writes nowhere, so only a base64url encoding
# can hold one — and where twenty-eight base62 characters follow, the run from
# the prefix to the end of them is redacted whether or not Render issued it.
# Such a run is a key's format exactly and nothing in the text tells the two
# apart, so sparing it would spare a real key written the same way.
#
# The digest is the same over-match taking a value a reader had a use for.
# Hexadecimal digits are base62 and a digest carries nothing that ends a run, so
# every digest written behind the prefix runs past a floor as low as this one:
# an MD5 is thirty-two characters, a SHA-1 forty and a SHA-256 sixty-four. What
# holds either side of it is the floor and the prefix — a run of sixteen is
# twelve characters short of a body, and a hyphen is no character the prefix
# carries.

case:     the prefix inside a longer run of base64url
in:       payload=zzzzrnd_0123456789abcdef0123456789abzzzz
out:      payload=zzzz«render-api-key»

case:     the prefix where a signature stands
in:       eyJhbGciOiJIUzI1NiJ9.eyJzdWIiOiJhYmMifQ.zzzzrnd_0123456789abcdef0123456789abzzzz
out:      eyJhbGciOiJIUzI1NiJ9.eyJzdWIiOiJhYmMifQ.zzzz«render-api-key»

case:     an md5 behind the prefix
in:       rnd_0123456789abcdef0123456789abcdef
out:      «render-api-key»

case:     a sha1 behind the prefix in a cache key
in:       key: rnd_0123456789abcdef0123456789abcdef01234567
out:      key: «render-api-key»

case:     a sha256 behind the prefix
in:       rnd_0123456789abcdef0123456789abcdef0123456789abcdef0123456789abcdef
out:      «render-api-key»

case:     a run of sixteen behind the prefix, twelve characters short of a body
in:       rnd_0123456789abcdef
out:      rnd_0123456789abcdef

case:     an md5 behind a hyphen rather than the prefix
in:       rnd-0123456789abcdef0123456789abcdef
out:      rnd-0123456789abcdef0123456789abcdef

# The prefix written in a case Render does not issue keys in, the prefix without
# the underscore it closes with, and a body of the right length with no prefix
# at all.

case:     an uppercase prefix
in:       RND_0123456789abcdef0123456789ab
out:      RND_0123456789abcdef0123456789ab

case:     the prefix without its closing underscore
in:       rnd0123456789abcdef0123456789ab
out:      rnd0123456789abcdef0123456789ab

case:     a run of the right length opening with no prefix
in:       0123456789abcdef0123456789ab
out:      0123456789abcdef0123456789ab
